segments.he: גְּמָ' דְּאָמַר מָר: טָבַל וְעָלָה — אוֹכֵל בְּמַעֲשֵׂר.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The mishna teaches that Beit Shammai concede to Beit Hillel that the woman observing the days of purity partakes of second-tithe produce. The Gemara explains that the reason is «as the Master said:» When the period of ritual impurity of a zav or leper has been completed, and he «immersed» during the day «and ascended» from the ritual bath, he «may partake of» second «tithe» immediately.
